TITLE: KDM2B controls HIF levels and activity through its JmjC and CxxC domains
DOI: 10.64898/2026.03.26.714448

ABSTRACT: AbstractHypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs) are key regulators of cellular responses to low oxygen (hypoxia), controlling the expression of genes required for survival and adaptation. KDM2B, a chromatin-modifying enzyme, is a direct target of HIF-1α, but its precise role in regulating HIF and the hypoxia response remains unclear. Here, we investigated the role of KDM2B in the response to hypoxia in a variety of cell lines. Our analysis reveals that KDM2B depletion regulates HIF activity in a cell type-dependent manner, with KDM2B depletion decreasing HIF activity in U2OS and MDA-MB-231 cells and increasing HIF activity in HeLa cells. We show that KDM2B depletion also reduces HIF-1α protein and RNA expression and reduces HIF-1α binding at hypoxia-response elements of its target genes in U2OS and MDA-MB-231 cells. Conversely, overexpression of KDM2B enhances HIF activity and HIF-1α levels in both U2OS and HEK293 cells. Mechanistically, we find that KDM2B requires its JmjC demethylase and CxxC DNA-binding domains for HIF regulation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that KDM2B is required for RNA Pol II recruitment to the promoter of HIF1A. At the cellular level, KDM2B supports cell proliferation, with its depletion impairing proliferation and reducing cell numbers under hypoxic conditions. Our work highlights a new function of KDM2B as a key regulator of HIF-1α expression, acting through its demethylase and DNA-binding functions. Our data indicate that KDM2B is essential for cellular adaptation to hypoxia, impacting both HIF-dependent gene expression and cell survival, and has important implications for our understanding of HIF regulation.

[s4.1] Methods > Reagents and tools table


[s4.2] Methods > Cell lines
HeLa, U2OS, and MDA-MB-231 cell lines were maintained in DMEM supplemented with 10% v/v FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, 100 units/mL penicillin, and 100 µg/mL streptomycin. U2OS-HRE (hypoxia response element), MDA-MB-231-HRE, HeLa-HRE, and HEK293-HRE luciferase lines were generated in the lab by co-transfection with a HRE luciferase plasmid containing 3 copies of 21 bps of the iNOS 21bp HRE (5’-AGTGACTACGTGCTGCCTAGG-‘3) subcloned into KpnI and MluI restriction sites of the pGL3 promoter vector (Promega), which was kindly gifted by G. Melillo (National Cancer Institute, National Institutes of Health, Bethesda, MD), together with a puromycin-resistance gene containing vector. U2OS-κB luciferase cells were generated in the lab by transfection with the pGL4.32(luc2P/NF-κB-RE/Hygro) vector. Additionally, 0.5μg/mL puromycin was added to cell culture media for U2OS-HRE, MDA-MB-231-HRE, and HEK293-HRE luciferase cell lines, and 150 μg/mL hygromycin for U2OS-κB luciferase cells. Cell lines were cultured for no more than 30 passages and routinely tested for mycoplasma contamination using a MycoAlert Mycoplasma Detection Kit.

[s4.3] Methods > Cell treatments
Hypoxia treatments were performed by incubating cells in an Invivo2 300 hypoxia workstation (Baker Ruskin) at 1% O2, 5% CO2, and 37 °C. To avoid reoxygenation, cells were lysed in the workstation. TNF-α (Peprotech) was dissolved in PBS and used at a final concentration of 10 ng/mL.

[s4.4] Methods > siRNA transfections
HEK293 cells were transfected in 35mm plates with a final concentration of 27 nM of siRNA by mixing siRNA, 0.12 M CaCl2, HEPES buffered saline (0.156 M NaCl, 0.375 M Na2HPO4, and 10mM HEPES), and water at a final volume of 400 µL and adding to cells. All other cell lines were transfected in 35mm plates with a final concentration of 27 nM of siRNA using Interferin (Poluplus, VWR) transfection reagent. For reverse transfections, the transfection mixture was added to the media immediately before cell seeding.

[s4.9] Methods > Luciferase assay
Cells were lysed in Passive lysis buffer. Luciferase activity was measured using a Luciferase Assay System kit and normalised to protein concentration determined by Bradford assay using Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent.

You are reviewing a liquid-handling protocol that another model produced from the paper sections above, for the experiment "HRE-luciferase reporter assay after KDM2B siRNA knockdown in normoxia and hypoxia" (Figure 1B).

PROTOCOL:
HRE-luciferase reporter assay after KDM2B siRNA knockdown in normoxia and hypoxia (U2OS, MDA-MB-231, HeLa HRE-luciferase cells; 96-well format)

Containers:
- plate_norm: 96-well plate — 96-well (ideally white, clear-bottom) cell plate kept at 21% O2; 3 cell lines x 3 siRNAs x 3 replicate wells [assumed]
- plate_hypo: 96-well plate — 96-well (ideally white, clear-bottom) cell plate moved to 1% O2 for the last 24 h; same layout as plate_norm [assumed]
- plate_bradford: 96-well plate — Clear 96-well plate for Bradford protein assay of lysates (norm in A1:C9, hypo in D1:F9) [assumed]
- tube_cells_U2OS: 15 mL tube — U2OS-HRE cell suspension in complete DMEM for seeding [assumed]
- tube_cells_MDA: 15 mL tube — MDA-MB-231-HRE cell suspension in complete DMEM for seeding [assumed]
- tube_cells_HeLa: 15 mL tube — HeLa-HRE cell suspension in complete DMEM for seeding [assumed]
- tube_siCtrl_stock: 1.5 mL tube — Control siRNA stock, 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_siKDM2B_1_stock: 1.5 mL tube — KDM2B_1 siRNA stock, 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_siKDM2B_2_stock: 1.5 mL tube — KDM2B_2 siRNA stock, 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_interferin: 1.5 mL tube — INTERFERin transfection reagent (Polyplus)
- tube_serumfree_DMEM: 15 mL tube — Serum-free DMEM for diluting transfection complexes [assumed]
- tube_mix_Ctrl: 1.5 mL tube — Transfection complex master mix, control siRNA [assumed]
- tube_mix_KDM2B_1: 1.5 mL tube — Transfection complex master mix, KDM2B_1 siRNA [assumed]
- tube_mix_KDM2B_2: 1.5 mL tube — Transfection complex master mix, KDM2B_2 siRNA [assumed]
- res_PBS: reservoir — PBS for washing cells [assumed]
- tube_PLB: 15 mL tube — 1x Passive Lysis Buffer
- tube_LAR: 15 mL tube — Luciferase Assay Reagent (Luciferase Assay System kit)
- res_Bradford: reservoir — Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent, diluted 1:5 in water
- waste: waste container — Liquid waste [assumed]

Starting contents:
- tube_cells_U2OS: 2500 µL U2OS-HRE cells at 5.5e4 cells/mL in complete DMEM (10% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, pen/strep, no puromycin) [assumed]
- tube_cells_MDA: 2500 µL MDA-MB-231-HRE cells at 5.5e4 cells/mL in complete DMEM (10% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, pen/strep, no puromycin) [assumed]
- tube_cells_HeLa: 2500 µL HeLa-HRE cells at 5.5e4 cells/mL in complete DMEM (10% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, pen/strep, no puromycin) [assumed]
- tube_siCtrl_stock: stock Control siRNA 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_siKDM2B_1_stock: stock KDM2B_1 siRNA 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_siKDM2B_2_stock: stock KDM2B_2 siRNA 1 µM [assumed]
- tube_interferin: stock INTERFERin transfection reagent
- tube_serumfree_DMEM: stock Serum-free DMEM [assumed]
- res_PBS: stock PBS [assumed]
- tube_PLB: stock 1x Passive Lysis Buffer
- tube_LAR: stock Luciferase Assay Reagent
- res_Bradford: stock Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent, 1:5 diluted [assumed]

Steps:
1. MANUAL: Harvest exponentially growing U2OS-HRE, MDA-MB-231-HRE and HeLa-HRE cells (maintained in DMEM + 10% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 µg/mL streptomycin, with 0.5 µg/mL puromycin for the HRE lines) by trypsinisation, count, and resuspend each line at 5.5e4 cells/mL in complete DMEM without puromycin in tube_cells_U2OS, tube_cells_MDA and tube_cells_HeLa. Note: Seeding density and cell preparation are not stated in the paper. [assumed]
2. Transfer 138 µL of Serum-free DMEM from tube_serumfree_DMEM to tube_mix_Ctrl. Note: Complex master mix prepared for 20 wells (18 needed + overage). [assumed]
3. Transfer 138 µL of Serum-free DMEM from tube_serumfree_DMEM to tube_mix_KDM2B_1. [assumed]
4. Transfer 138 µL of Serum-free DMEM from tube_serumfree_DMEM to tube_mix_KDM2B_2. [assumed]
5. Transfer 54 µL of Control siRNA 1 µM from tube_siCtrl_stock to tube_mix_Ctrl. Note: 2.7 µL of 1 µM siRNA per 100 µL final well volume gives 27 nM; x20 wells. [assumed]
6. Transfer 54 µL of KDM2B_1 siRNA 1 µM from tube_siKDM2B_1_stock to tube_mix_KDM2B_1. [assumed]
7. Transfer 54 µL of KDM2B_2 siRNA 1 µM from tube_siKDM2B_2_stock to tube_mix_KDM2B_2. [assumed]
8. Transfer 8 µL of INTERFERin from tube_interferin to tube_mix_Ctrl. Note: 0.4 µL per well x20 wells; volume per well scaled to 96-well format. [assumed]
9. Transfer 8 µL of INTERFERin from tube_interferin to tube_mix_KDM2B_1. [assumed]
10. Transfer 8 µL of INTERFERin from tube_interferin to tube_mix_KDM2B_2. [assumed]
11. Mix tube_mix_Ctrl by pipetting 100 µL up and down 5 times. [assumed]
12. Mix tube_mix_KDM2B_1 by pipetting 100 µL up and down 5 times. [assumed]
13. Mix tube_mix_KDM2B_2 by pipetting 100 µL up and down 5 times. [assumed]
14. MANUAL: Incubate the three transfection master mixes 10 min at room temperature to allow complex formation. Note: Standard INTERFERin practice; not stated in paper. [assumed]
15. Transfer 10 µL of Control siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_Ctrl to plate_norm wells A1:A9 (each well). Note: Complex added to empty wells before seeding (reverse transfection). [assumed]
16. Transfer 10 µL of KDM2B_1 siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_KDM2B_1 to plate_norm wells B1:B9 (each well). [assumed]
17. Transfer 10 µL of KDM2B_2 siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_KDM2B_2 to plate_norm wells C1:C9 (each well). [assumed]
18. Transfer 10 µL of Control siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_Ctrl to plate_hypo wells A1:A9 (each well). [assumed]
19. Transfer 10 µL of KDM2B_1 siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_KDM2B_1 to plate_hypo wells B1:B9 (each well). [assumed]
20. Transfer 10 µL of KDM2B_2 siRNA/INTERFERin complex from tube_mix_KDM2B_2 to plate_hypo wells C1:C9 (each well). [assumed]
21. Transfer 90 µL of U2OS-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_U2OS to plate_norm wells A1:C3 (each well), then mix 2 times. Note: U2OS in columns 1-3; ~5,000 cells/well; final volume 100 µL/well. [assumed]
22. Transfer 90 µL of MDA-MB-231-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_MDA to plate_norm wells A4:C6 (each well), then mix 2 times. Note: MDA-MB-231 in columns 4-6. [assumed]
23. Transfer 90 µL of HeLa-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_HeLa to plate_norm wells A7:C9 (each well), then mix 2 times. Note: HeLa in columns 7-9. [assumed]
24. Transfer 90 µL of U2OS-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_U2OS to plate_hypo wells A1:C3 (each well), then mix 2 times. [assumed]
25. Transfer 90 µL of MDA-MB-231-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_MDA to plate_hypo wells A4:C6 (each well), then mix 2 times. [assumed]
26. Transfer 90 µL of HeLa-HRE cell suspension from tube_cells_HeLa to plate_hypo wells A7:C9 (each well), then mix 2 times. [assumed]
27. MANUAL: Incubate plate_norm and plate_hypo for 24 h at 37 °C, 5% CO2, 21% O2. Note: Hypoxia is applied for the final 24 h of the 48 h siRNA treatment. [assumed]
28. MANUAL: Move plate_hypo into the Invivo2 300 hypoxia workstation and incubate 24 h at 1% O2, 5% CO2, 37 °C; keep plate_norm for the same 24 h at 21% O2, 5% CO2, 37 °C (total 48 h after transfection).
29. Transfer 100 µL of Culture medium from plate_hypo wells A1:C9 to waste. Note: Performed inside the hypoxia workstation. [assumed]
30. Transfer 100 µL of PBS from res_PBS to plate_hypo wells A1:C9 (each well). Note: PBS wash assumed; use PBS pre-equilibrated in the workstation. [assumed]
31. Transfer 100 µL of PBS from plate_hypo wells A1:C9 to waste. [assumed]
32. Transfer 20 µL of 1x Passive Lysis Buffer from tube_PLB to plate_hypo wells A1:C9 (each well). Note: 20 µL/well is the manufacturer's standard for 96-well plates; lysed inside the workstation. [assumed]
33. Transfer 100 µL of Culture medium from plate_norm wells A1:C9 to waste. [assumed]
34. Transfer 100 µL of PBS from res_PBS to plate_norm wells A1:C9 (each well). [assumed]
35. Transfer 100 µL of PBS from plate_norm wells A1:C9 to waste. [assumed]
36. Transfer 20 µL of 1x Passive Lysis Buffer from tube_PLB to plate_norm wells A1:C9 (each well). [assumed]
37. MANUAL: Shake plate_norm and plate_hypo (the latter still in the workstation) for 15 min at room temperature to lyse cells. Note: Lysis time per standard Passive Lysis Buffer protocol. [assumed]
38. Transfer 5 µL of Cell lysate from plate_norm wells A1:C9 to plate_bradford wells A1:C9 (each well). Note: 5 µL of lysate reserved for protein determination; 15 µL remains for luciferase. [assumed]
39. Transfer 5 µL of Cell lysate from plate_hypo wells A1:C9 to plate_bradford wells D1:F9 (each well). [assumed]
40. Transfer 250 µL of Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent (1:5 diluted) from res_Bradford to plate_bradford wells A1:F9 (each well). Note: Standard microplate Bradford volumes. [assumed]
41. MANUAL: Incubate plate_bradford 5 min at room temperature and read absorbance at 595 nm (BSA standard curve prepared separately). [assumed]
42. Transfer 100 µL of Luciferase Assay Reagent from tube_LAR to plate_norm wells A1:C9 (each well). Note: Standard manufacturer volume of 100 µL reagent per well. [assumed]
43. Transfer 100 µL of Luciferase Assay Reagent from tube_LAR to plate_hypo wells A1:C9 (each well). [assumed]
44. MANUAL: Measure luminescence of plate_norm and plate_hypo in a plate luminometer (2 s delay, 10 s integration); normalise luminescence to protein concentration from Bradford assay. Note: Luminometer settings assumed. [assumed]

Assumptions:
- Layout on both plate_norm (21% O2) and plate_hypo (1% O2): rows A/B/C = control / KDM2B_1 / KDM2B_2 siRNA; columns 1-3 = U2OS-HRE, 4-6 = MDA-MB-231-HRE, 7-9 = HeLa-HRE; the 3 columns per cell line are the 3 replicates. Replicates are in-plate wells rather than independent experiments.
- Plate_bradford layout: lysates from plate_norm in A1:C9, from plate_hypo in D1:F9.
- 35 mm dish scaled to a 96-well plate (~0.32 cm2 vs ~9.6 cm2) and rounded to 100 µL final volume per well (10 µL transfection complex + 90 µL cell suspension).
- Final siRNA concentration 27 nM as in the paper; achieved with 2.7 µL of an assumed 1 µM siRNA stock per well. The INTERFERin amount (0.4 µL/well) and 10 min complex formation are assumed standard manufacturer values; calcium phosphate transfection (HEK293) not used here.
- Master mixes prepared for 20 wells per siRNA (18 needed) in serum-free DMEM.
- Seeding density ~5,000 cells/well (5.5e4 cells/mL) is assumed; seeding medium assumed to omit puromycin; cell harvest and counting are not detailed in the paper.
- Reverse transfection: complex added to empty wells then cells seeded on top, mixed with 2 cycles after dispensing.
- Timeline assumed from Figure 1B legend: 48 h siRNA treatment, with the hypoxia plate placed at 1% O2 for the final 24 h; plate_norm stays at 21% O2.
- PBS wash before lysis assumed; medium removed from plates fully before adding lysis buffer; hypoxic plate handled and lysed inside the hypoxia workstation to avoid reoxygenation.
- Passive Lysis Buffer 20 µL/well, 15 min shaking; 5 µL lysate used for Bradford; luciferase reagent 100 µL added to the remaining 15 µL lysate directly in the cell plate (white plate assumed). Bradford dye diluted 1:5, 250 µL/well; standard curve prepared separately.
- Luminometer settings (2 s delay, 10 s integration) are assumed.
- Puromycin (0.5 µg/mL) selection of HRE lines is used during routine maintenance; not included during the siRNA experiment (assumed).
- Volumes of stocks (siRNA, INTERFERin, buffers) are listed as null/ample; cell suspension tubes assumed to contain 2500 µL.

none

Review it against the paper. Look for:
- steps from the paper that are missing, or steps that are out of bench order
- numbers (volumes, concentrations, times, temperatures, cell numbers) that contradict the paper
- assumptions that are unreasonable or contradict standard practice
- well layouts that don't cover the conditions/controls in the paper
- causes of the automated check findings
Only flag real problems; minor wording does not matter. Refer to steps by number.
